title: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers for One-Handed Use
h1: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers for One-Handed Use
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for electric can openers for one-handed use, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric can openers for one-handed use using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart Deluxe Electric Can Opener CCO-50N
products.blurb: Key specs: Nonslip wide base, Single-touch automatic operation, Automatic stop.
strengths: Nonslip base stays fully put with one hand positioning the can, no bracing needed
Single-touch start and automatic stop mean nothing needs holding through the cycle
Detachable lever simplifies one-handed cleaning under the tap
limitations: Costs more than the Hamilton Beach at typical pricing
No magnetic lid lift, so the cut lid still needs to be picked off manually
Bulkier footprint takes more counter space than a handheld model

products.name: Hamilton Beach Smooth Touch Electric Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Single push-down lever, Extra-tall opening, Smooth-edge cutting.
strengths: Push-down lever needs just one light press with the same hand placing the can
Wide base holds position without bracing against the counter or body
Also opens pop-top cans one-handed, which many electric openers skip
limitations: No automatic lid lift, so the lid still needs picking off after the cut
Permanent countertop footprint rather than a stow-away design

products.name: Black+Decker Spacemaker EC600 Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Under-cabinet mounting, One-touch lever, Fixed, permanent installation.
strengths: Fixed mounting means the unit never needs steadying, only the can does
One-touch lever is a simple, light one-handed action once installed
Frees the counter, leaving more room to maneuver a can with one hand
limitations: Requires a one-time two-handed installation to mount under the cabinet
Fixed height might not suit every reach comfortably

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
